description: The `build-scatter` test groups (research/notes/build-scatter-plan.md). Two ARMCK of the human seat and, on each of the two places where the test group has them build a solar collector, four idle ARMPW: site A south-west of the pinned camera centre, where builder A stands, and site B south-east of it, a longer walk for builder B from the north-west. The test group selects each builder with a native click, arms the solar through its build panel and clicks the site under the units: the cursor accepts both, each builder's site is refused on arrival and its four units are moved off it. At site A one moved unit is then ordered away by hand and one back onto the site, and the solar is built; at site B the step build-scatter-clear.json removes every unit while the four are walking off and their builder waits. That step's units are a third site's: build-scatter-wreck.json puts a wreck on it after the cursor accepted it, so its units are moved and its builder then waits and gives up as stock.
